newsitem.title: UK: Verity up as Investors Chronicle says "buy".
newsitem.headline: Verity up as Investors Chronicle says "buy".

text.p: Shares in Verity Group touched new highs on Friday after Investors Chronicle magazine recommended buying the electronic audio and musical instruments maker, market makers said.
Verity shares hit a record 35p in morning trade before easing back to 34p, up 1-1/2p on the day. The stock led volumes in London, with over 9.6 million shares traded.
Investors Chronicle said the group had developed what it called a revolutionary flat loudspeaker and said applications for the new technology were "exciting".
"This is a chance for a risky bet on something new," it said.
The magazine noted Verity shares have doubled in price since it announced the flat loudspeaker development. The shares started the year around 12p.
"The shares are a punt on a new invention but they offer huge potential upside," Investors Chronicle said.
It said Verity's existing businesses were growing steadily but slowly and justified no more than a market rating. But the new technology could reap substantial licensing revenue.
